purpose: Closed product-category taxonomy used by the JSON cleaning pipeline.

normalization.matching: Canonical name or alias after normalized lookup.
normalization.unknown_policy: Keep records with an unmapped product category as null.

registry.unknown_policy: Keep an unmapped product category as null.

definitions.definition: Everyday, formal, work, children’s, and occasion clothing sold as the primary product.
excludes: retail-store brand campaigns without a featured apparel offer

definitions.definition: Casual, formal, lifestyle, and occupational shoes sold as the primary product.
excludes: shoe retailers advertising the store rather than a product line

definitions.definition: Athletic clothing, jerseys, and performance footwear whose advertised object is wearable apparel.
Personal carry products and leather accessories sold primarily for fashion or everyday use.
Decorative jewelry and non-computing watches marketed as personal accessories.
excludes: generic luxury positioning without product evidence

definitions.definition: Wearable or carried fashion accessories not covered by clothing, footwear, bags, jewelry, or watches.
Cosmetic products primarily used to alter or enhance visible appearance.
Non-prescription products for cleansing, moisturizing, protecting, or improving skin appearance.
Consumer products and tools for washing, treating, coloring, or styling hair.
Personal fragrance products applied to the body.
excludes: generic luxury campaigns without fragrance evidence

definitions.definition: Routine consumer hygiene and oral-care products, including non-clinical electric tools.
Consumer devices and tools whose primary purpose is personal grooming or cosmetic treatment.
Packaged foods, pantry products, ingredients, and meal components for human consumption.
Sweet and savory snack foods sold for immediate or occasional consumption.
Ready-to-drink or mixable beverages without alcohol.
Beer, wine, spirits, and alcoholic ready-to-drink products.
Milk, yogurt, cheese, and plant-based substitutes marketed as food or drink.
Restaurants, cafés, quick-service chains, and prepared-meal services advertising food or dining.
Coffee, tea, and related consumables marketed as beverages or ingredients.
Large and small appliances whose primary function serves household tasks.
Furniture, bedding, décor, lighting, storage, and non-electronic home furnishings.
Products for cleaning, disinfecting, laundering, and maintaining household spaces and textiles.
Consumer home renovation, repair, DIY, garden, and residential building products.
Non-food products for cooking, serving, and kitchen organization.
Consumer-facing residential property, moving, maintenance, and in-home services.
Phones, tablets, laptops, desktops, and personal computing hardware.
Consumer devices for listening, recording, and home audio playback.
Consumer cameras and imaging hardware whose primary function is capturing photos or video.
Connected wearable hardware with computing, communication, or general wellness functions.

definitions.name_zh: 家庭娱乐与智能家居电子
definitions.definition: Connected electronics for home entertainment, automation, and monitoring.
Accessories and hardware used to power, connect, store, or extend consumer electronic devices.
Physical consumer hardware primarily used to play or control video games.
Department stores, mass merchants, and multi-category retailers advertising their store or assortment.
Supermarkets and grocery retailers advertising the store, assortment, price, or shopping service.
Retail businesses specializing in a product domain while advertising the store or assortment rather than a manufacturer product.

definitions.name_zh: 交易市场与分类信息平台
definitions.definition: Platforms primarily matching buyers and sellers or enabling multi-merchant transactions.
excludes: social networks without a primary commerce offer

definitions.name_zh: 消费者配送与商业平台
definitions.definition: Consumer platforms whose primary offer is ordering and last-mile delivery across multiple merchants or product types.
Consumer-facing shopping memberships, loyalty programs, coupons, and merchant-linked commerce services.
excludes: retailer campaigns not centered on the service

definitions.definition: Cars and light passenger vehicles sold for personal or household transportation.
Road vehicles sold primarily for commercial transport, work, or fleet use.
Motorized two- and three-wheel vehicles marketed for transport or recreation.
Bicycles and lightweight mobility products advertised primarily for everyday transportation.

definitions.name_zh: 网约车、租赁与出行服务
definitions.definition: Consumer services providing temporary access to vehicles or local point-to-point mobility.

definitions.name_zh: 汽车零部件、养护与后市场
definitions.definition: Consumer vehicle components, tires, accessories, maintenance, repair, and car-care offers.
Consumer bank accounts, cards, wallets, transfers, and payment services.
Consumer and small-business borrowing products whose core offer is credit.
Products transferring financial risk for individuals, property, health, travel, vehicles, or businesses.
Investment products, brokerage, asset management, retirement, and wealth-advisory offers.

definitions.name_zh: 金融科技与数字金融平台
definitions.definition: Technology-led services whose primary user outcome is financial rather than general software productivity.
Financial services whose primary customer is a business or institution.
Hospitals, clinics, telehealth, laboratories, and licensed clinical care services.
Prescription medicines and branded therapies intended for treatment under professional supervision.
excludes: public disease-awareness campaigns without a product

definitions.definition: Non-prescription medicines and evidence-based consumer health products used to prevent or relieve symptoms.
Devices and tests primarily intended for diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, or clinical rehabilitation.

definitions.name_zh: 维生素、营养补充与健康管理
definitions.definition: Human dietary supplements and wellness products marketed around health maintenance rather than food enjoyment.
Clinical dental, optical, and specialist-care services or treatment products.
Clinical or professional services and products for mental and behavioral health support.
excludes: social advocacy without a care service

definitions.definition: Equipment and accessories used primarily for structured exercise and fitness training.
Hard goods and protective equipment used to play organized or recreational sports.
Hard goods and equipment for camping, hiking, climbing, water, snow, and adventure recreation.

definitions.name_zh: 健身房、训练与健身服务
definitions.definition: Facilities, memberships, coaching, and services whose primary offer is exercise or sports training.
Non-clinical products used for routine athletic recovery, mobility, and massage.

definitions.name_zh: 竞技与运动自行车装备
definitions.definition: Bicycles and equipment advertised primarily for sport, racing, trail, or performance recreation.
Audiovisual content, broadcasters, studios, and subscription video services.
Recorded music, radio, podcasts, and audio-content services.
Books, magazines, newspapers, news brands, and publishing services offered as content.
Cultural institutions, exhibitions, and artistic experiences offered to audiences.
Ticketed live events and entertainment attractions whose primary offer is audience experience.
Sports leagues, broadcasts, spectator events, and fan-content services sold as entertainment.
Console, PC, cloud, and immersive games sold as interactive entertainment software.
Games primarily distributed through mobile devices or social platforms.
Physical games played with boards, cards, pieces, or tabletop systems.
Physical toys and play products primarily intended for children.
Physical collectibles and hobby products sold for fandom, making, or collection.
Regulated wagering, casino, and lottery products offered as entertainment.
Formal early-childhood, primary, and secondary education institutions and services.
Universities, colleges, and degree-granting post-secondary institutions.
Skills, certification, workforce, and professional-development education.
Digital products whose primary user outcome is structured learning or education delivery.
Services focused on tutoring, academic preparation, testing, and learner assessment.
Curriculum-led materials and education support services whose primary function is learning.
Software for documents, communication, meetings, project work, and personal or team productivity.
Software supporting business operations, commerce, customer management, finance operations, or workforce processes.

definitions.name_zh: 云、人工智能与开发者平台
definitions.definition: Infrastructure, AI, data, and developer platforms offered primarily as technology services.
Digital security products protecting identities, devices, networks, data, or transactions.
excludes: security consulting without a software product

definitions.definition: Software for creating, editing, designing, publishing, or managing digital content.
Digital platforms whose primary offer is user communication, social interaction, or community participation.
Consumer software and online services providing a practical non-financial, non-education utility.
Consumer cellular voice, data, roaming, and mobile-network plans.
Consumer fixed-line internet and home connectivity services.
Operator bundles combining mobile, internet, voice, television access, or household connectivity.
Connectivity services delivered primarily through satellite or specialized remote networks.
Managed network access and communications connectivity sold primarily to organizations.
Passenger airlines and air-travel services advertising routes, cabins, fares, or flight experience.
Temporary accommodation and hospitality stays sold to travelers.
Places and tourism organizations advertising travel to a destination.
Platforms and operators whose primary offer is planning, booking, packaging, or guiding travel.
Scheduled passenger transport sold as an intercity or travel experience.
Cruise lines and journey products combining transport, stay, and leisure experience.
Human-led expertise sold to organizations or individuals as a professional service.
Human-led agency and business support services sold primarily to organizations.
Services providing people, workplace operations, facilities, or outsourced business functions.
Machinery and equipment primarily purchased for industrial, construction, agricultural, or commercial operations.

definitions.name_zh: 制造、材料与工业投入品
definitions.definition: Manufactured components, raw materials, chemicals, and inputs sold primarily to organizations.

definitions.name_zh: 企业物流、货运与供应链
definitions.definition: Freight, warehousing, and supply-chain services whose primary customer is an organization.
B2B construction, engineering, infrastructure, and commercial-property products or services.
Government agencies and public institutions communicating access to civic services or programs.

definitions.name_zh: 慈善、募款与非营利服务
definitions.definition: Nonprofit organizations seeking donations, volunteers, membership, or use of social services.
Cause-led campaigns seeking awareness or action on social, equality, welfare, or human-rights issues.
Noncommercial campaigns seeking environmental protection, climate action, or conservation behavior.
Noncommercial campaigns promoting public-health, safety, prevention, or emergency behavior without selling a healthcare offer.
excludes: vehicle safety features sold as products

definitions.definition: Campaigns seeking voting, civic participation, policy support, or political representation.
Food, treats, and routine nutrition products for companion animals.
Products and services for pet cleaning, grooming, odor control, and toileting.
Non-electronic accessories for walking, feeding, training, play, and enrichment.
Electronic and connected devices designed primarily for pet care, monitoring, feeding, or location.

definitions.name_zh: 宠物健康、营养补充与兽医护理
definitions.definition: Health products, medicines, supplements, insurance-adjacent care, and veterinary services for companion animals.
Products for pet rest, containment, transport, travel, and integration into the home.
Regulated or commercial services supplying electricity or gas to homes and organizations.
Products and services generating or storing renewable energy for homes, businesses, or grids.
Consumer and commercial fuels, lubricants, and energy products used to power or maintain vehicles and machinery.

definitions.name_zh: 电动车充电与能源网络
definitions.definition: Public, fleet, or home-connected charging networks and energy services for electric mobility.
Energy production, resource, and efficiency services sold primarily to industrial or commercial customers.

definitions.name_zh: 水务、废弃物与环境公用事业
definitions.definition: Utility and infrastructure services for water, waste collection, recycling, and environmental operations.
